title: The Great Alone
author: Kristin Hannah
summary: In the 1970s, a former prisoner of war moves his wife and thirteen-year-old daughter to a remote Alaskan homestead. As the dark winters close in, the girl watches her father's moods grow more dangerous.
readIf: you want a gripping, atmospheric family drama set in wild country with a strong coming-of-age strand.
skipIf: you want to avoid stories about domestic abuse, which is central and often painful here.

pairings.reason: Another girl growing up on the edge of a wild landscape, with nature as a real presence.
Same author, with another resilient woman facing hardship and a bleak landscape.
Another family driven into unfamiliar territory by a controlling father, with a similar mix of dread and love.
